captions.detailed: This 3D model is an angled skateboard riser pad with a rectangular profile and rounded corners. It features a wedge-like slope along its length, creating a height differential from one end to the other. Four circular mounting holes are positioned near the corners, aligned perpendicular to the angled top face to accommodate standard truck mounting screws.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric skateboard riser pad in OpenSCAD that allows customization of width, length, minimum height, and wedge angle. The script should support switching between 'Old School' and 'New School' truck hole patterns, and include an option to add custom embossed text on the side of the riser.
captions.factory: The script uses the external MCAD/boxes.scad library to generate a 'roundedBox' as the base shape. It constructs the angled portion by rotating a roundedBox by the user-defined Riser_Angle, cuts off the bottom half using a difference operation with a large cube, and unions it with a flat bottom roundedBox representing the minimum height. Four mounting cylinders are subtracted using the difference operator based on the selected 'Old School' or 'New School' dimensional constants, and the 'write' module is used to apply custom text to the side.
